cited.quote: afforestation and reforestation to enhance forest and tree cover

rationale: C1 only states general forest policy aims; C3 and C4 are unrelated GOs (force modernization, wildlife habitat funding). No official step toward raising forest cover to 33% by 2031 appears in the extracts.

cited.quote: SIPCOT is identifying new land parcels throughout the State for creating industrial land banks

rationale: C2 describes SIPCOT identifying new land parcels and C1 a land allotment portal, but neither shows an official step to fully utilise vacant SIPCOT lands or allot them within a deadline. Only related activity.

None of the extracts (C1-C5) mention the Makkal Seva Nanbar or doorstep delivery of scheme benefits; they cover differently abled schemes, pensions, housing, a newborn gold ring scheme and health insurance.

cited.quote: senior citizen day care centres featuring libraries, yoga and meditation facilities and indoor sports

rationale: C1 (budget speech) and C2 (policy note) only say such centres will be set up in 5 districts, with an allocation. No GO or operational step is shown. Announcement and allocation only.

cited.quote: In the Eastern Ghats, 304 ha. receive in-situ protection and cultural operations

rationale: C2 reports continuing sandalwood protection in the Eastern Ghats under a scheme running from 2021-22, not a new dedicated measure, and no regulation or cooperation with indigenous peoples is shown. Same activity carrying on.
No extract concerns people deciding how 10% of development funds are allocated in districts. C1-C5 cover AMRUT, housing, minority schemes and urban funds, none of them participatory budgeting.

cited.quote: To make Tamil Nadu a leader in learning outcomes, an amount of

rationale: C3 is a budget speech allocating money for curriculum revision and announcing schemes; C1 and C2 describe existing support and planned training. No GO for a special learning-outcomes scheme is shown. Announcements only.

cited.quote: A detailed assessment of the participation of transgender persons in higher education will be undertaken

rationale: C3 only plans higher-education studies, not a released report on school learning outcomes and gender/social disparities. C1 describes existing SCERT academic support. No report released is shown.

cited.quote: conducting Thirukkural recitation competitions since the beginning of the millennium

rationale: C1 shows long-running recitation competitions and teacher training allocations, not Thirukkural introduced as a special subject in schools and business institutions. Other extracts are unrelated.

cited.quote: food commodities intended for distribution under Public Distribution System and other welfare schemes are being tested

rationale: C2 describes existing quality control duties and laboratory testing of PDS commodities; this is continuing activity, with no new GO or measure for strict checks at every stage shown. C1 covers complaints only.

cited.quote: the Singappen Special Task Force was created

rationale: Extracts show existing women's protection work (C1, C3) and a maternity leave GO (C4, C5), but no separate division for women and girls under the Chief Minister's supervision.
No extract is about 1,000 village industry clusters with integrated infrastructure. C2 covers farm clusters under a livelihood mission and C4 TANSIDCO mega clusters, which are different.
No extract concerns building storm and erosion resistant coastal houses under a scheme. C1 covers urban housing, C3 and C4 disaster management and rural works generally.

cited.quote: various drought mitigation projects will be implemented at a total cost of Rs.111 crore

rationale: C3 mentions drought mitigation projects in Virudhunagar and Ramanathapuram under a Union fund, which is related activity but not a declaration of the districts as drought zones. No order declaring drought zones appears.

cited.quote: 10 products have been granted Geographical Indication (GI) tags, namely Dindigul Locks (Dindigul)

rationale: C4 notes Dindigul Locks hold a GI tag, an existing status, and C1/C3 mention general export cells. No export certificates for Dindigul lock makers or specific market programme is shown.

cited.quote: established Urban Haat with the necessary infrastructure at the tourist destinations of Mamallapuram and Kanniyakumari

rationale: C1 reports existing Urban Haats at two tourist sites, not night markets near all cultural destinations. No new order or night market establishment is shown in the other extracts.

cited.quote: It also liaises with the Government of India and other stakeholders to support effective planning

rationale: C3 describes routine liaison on existing railway projects; no resolution, letter or order urging the Union government on a Tamil Nadu Railway Connection Line Project is shown.
No extract concerns the Thiruvallur steel rolling mill or an allocation of 300 crore for green production. C2 mentions an iron and steel market in Chennai, which is unrelated.

cited.quote: Tamil heritage and cultural sites along the East Coast Road will be upgraded

rationale: C3 budget speech announces allocation for a project report on heritage sites, and C4 the Governor's address states intent to continue Keezhadi research. No tabulated cultural and heritage budget or Keezhadi allocation is shown.

The promise does not name its service and no extract matches a free service for all Indians with commercial licences for foreigners; C1-C5 cover cable TV, fare concessions, beer export and health insurance.
